description: Searches RestaurantDoctorAI's sourced library: the website's guides and blog posts, the step-by-step fixes from the paid report's playbook, RestaurantDoctorAI's targets by type of restaurant, sourced industry facts, and an expert knowledge base of sourced how-tos, rules and checklists (costs, labor, money, growth, compliance, operations). Use it for a question about running a restaurant, to answer from these pages and cite them. Keyword search: "break-even", "breakeven" and "break even" are one term, and plurals match. Returns the best passages, each with its id, kind, title, link and source; kind narrows the search to one kind of entry, restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge lists what's there, and restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge gives an entry's full text. Quote figures with their source. RestaurantDoctorAI's targets are its own, not industry benchmarks. The query isn't stored; only an anonymous daily count of searches and reads is kept.

kind.description: Only this kind of entry: guide (the website's guides), post (blog posts), play (the step-by-step fixes from the paid report's playbook), targets (RestaurantDoctorAI's targets by type of restaurant), fact (sourced industry facts) or knowledge (sourced how-tos, rules and checklists). Left out, every kind.

limit.description: How many passages to return, 1 to 8 (default 5).

query.description: What to look up, in plain words, e.g. 'how to lower food cost', 'tip pool rules' or 'delivery app commission'.

name: restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge

hits.description: Best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

passage.description: The part of the entry that matched best.

source.description: Who says so, with the date it was checked or updated where there is one.

url.description: Where a reader can check it: the page on restaurantdoctorai.com, or the fact's own source.

title: Search RestaurantDoctorAI's library
